reviews.review:
This game is a rougelike similar to gunfire reborn. 

It really is a lot of fun actually, you get tons of movement options and real speed when sprinting. The sliding is also fun and easy to do. At first it feels very rogueLITE, The main way you get more powerful is through random perks when levelling up and collecting cores. Cores upgrade the damage of a specific weapon group and a static skill (like crit chance or explosion radius) This actually gives a lot of freedom because all you really need to do is like one weapon from each of the four trees rather than in gunfire waiting for the specific really good weapon to drop with all of the right perks attached to it. This also however does feel like it removes some of the random rogue elements, but as you go on and upgrade your base you eventually unlock a column that gives you weapon "affixes" these modify your weapons so you do eventually still get the potential random god weapon. but they aren't that in depth and only have small effects. this goes alongside allowing you to really play how you want with any weapon and the cores are generous too. you can only carry 3 but this means that you trade them out making it really easy to build towards whichever of the 4 weapon types you like. 

So far the story is quite short, only 2 bosses. but there are still a few different areas and paths to go between. the game is built on such a solid foundation that really the only thing that needs to change in early access is more levels and more enemy types. even as I make this review in the early days of the game I feel like i'm constantly discovering new weapons. 

As for design, i have never been huge on the cell shaded hype, in fact, its one of my least fave design choices. but that is personally preference. the environments are clean, varied and easy to read. Weapons have many different forms and firing styles and some are a joy to behold. the enemies are varied too and have different fire patterns and designs and look quite nice. (though i hate the shock bot from the first zone) 

In conclusion
Generally speaking i think the gameplay here is 10/10 with really solid controls and feel to it. it has great sometimes unique weapons with lots of diversity and the enemies are a joy to fight. the rogue elements are fun if a little light but they really prioritise choice, which is not a bad thing at all. There are some things that don't make it a 10/10 overall for sure its probably an 8 (and the current amount of levels maybe makes it a 6) but the gameplay is the real reason why we are here and i am pretty confident we will be getting new levels/bosses. 

I haven't noticed many bugs other than i think lag caused me to get stuck in a roof when playing coop. It runs well. it also has really good controller support if you are into that kind of thing (i personally rebound ability to LB and change weapon to Y and just unbound drop weapon)

Be warned, this is still very early access with about 4 hours of content. A lot of the systems that will add to game play complexity like items, meta progression, affixes and modifiers on weapons are not really implemented yet.

What is here, however, is a very strong foundation. The movement feels great, the music is great and most importantly the gun play feels great. No doubt it will feel even better once they build upon it.

EDIT: After years of early access, unfortunately save and exit has still not been implemented. In a game where a run can last 60+ minutes, this is not acceptable.
